name: Jia Chen Yee
bio: Jia Chen is an Apple Certified Trainer, developer, and community organizer based in Singapore, leading initiatives such as iOS Conf SG, Swift for Everyone, Swift Student Collective, and Spatial Singapore. Through his work, he creates experiences for students and developers across Asia. A two-time Swift Student Challenge winner (2020, 2021), he has been featured on Apple.com and continues to grow communities through events and initiatives.
